stockfish_dense_anchor.contract: SFNNv16 affine outputs and skip connection are int32 before clipped activations

hypothesis: The large-A0 fc0 and fc1 affine sums are int32 values, matching the frozen tensor and trace types. Requiring every admitted or runtime sum to fit int16 rejects otherwise valid SFNNv16 parameters without protecting any serialized or arithmetic boundary.

single_variable.before: fc0 and fc1 complete static intervals and runtime sums must fit signed int16
single_variable.after: fc0 and fc1 complete static intervals and runtime sums must fit signed int32

negative: all existing parser and transactional negatives

stopping_rule: Any identity, int32 interval, runtime range, parser, trace parity, transition, platform, warning or sanitizer mismatch rejects this subgate. No loss, speed or Elo observation may alter the bound after execution begins.
